mapper.sql: id, dashboard_id, widget_type, source_id, title, grid_x, grid_y, grid_w, grid_h, display_config, z_index, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.dashboard_id, w.widget_type, w.source_id, w.title, w.grid_x, w.grid_y, w.grid_w, w.grid_h, w.display_config, w.z_index, w.create_time, t.name as source_name, t.result_type as source_result_type FROM monitor_dashboard_widget w LEFT JOIN monitor_task t ON w.source_id = t.id AND w.widget_type = 'TASK' WHERE w.dashboard_id = #{dashboardId} ORDER BY w.z_index, w.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitor_dashboard_widget(dashboard_id, widget_type, source_id, title, grid_x, grid_y, grid_w, grid_h, display_config, z_index) VALUES(#{dashboardId}, #{widgetType}, #{sourceId}, #{title}, #{gridX}, #{gridY}, #{gridW}, #{gridH}, #{displayConfig}, #{zIndex})
